title: Live List Checker (frontend): hooks + user flow + admin panel section + amber/charcoal theme

requirements.summary: Add React Query hooks for Live List Checker admin and user operations (list, claims, approvals, totals, limits, contact info) aligned with existing hooks pattern.
acceptanceCriteria: All new backend methods needed by the UI have corresponding React Query hooks (queries/mutations) with cache invalidation similar to existing patterns (e.g., invalidating list/totals on mutation).
Errors such as ‘name already taken’ are surfaced to the UI via toast or inline messaging (English text).

file_operations.description: Extend the typed backend interface with Live List Checker methods and types (name list, claim record/status, totals, limits/settings, contact info) so the new hooks/UI compile against the actor. (No backend implementation here; just frontend typing.)

Add Live List Checker React Query hooks (queries/mutations) for: upload/replace name list (admin), fetch active list, create claim with required UPI ID, fetch claim status for a name, fetch admin claim queue(s) with filtering, approve/reject claims, fetch totals, and get/set limits + contact info. Follow existing patterns: useActor dependency gating, toast error/success, and invalidate relevant query keys after mutations.

requirements.summary: Implement user-facing Live List Checker flow (instructions, name availability, claim with UPI ID, status display, contact info display) within the existing customer view.
acceptanceCriteria: User can enter a name and submit a claim with a required UPI ID field.
If the name is already claimed, the UI shows an English message indicating it is already taken and does not create a new claim.
After submitting, the UI shows claim status as ‘Pending’ (and updates to ‘Approved’/‘Rejected’ after admin action).
User can see current contact info (including WhatsApp number) in the Live List Checker user view.

file_operations.description: Wire the Live List Checker into the existing customer view (e.g., as an additional sub-tab/section) without introducing a new top-level route. Include instructions, name input, availability/status display, and claim submission requiring UPI ID. Use the new Live List Checker hooks and show English inline/toast errors for taken/limit/auth failures. If authentication is required by backend, prompt user to log in before allowing claim submission (use existing Internet Identity integration; do not modify immutable auth hook files).

Create a dedicated user section component that renders the Live List Checker UI: instructions, name lookup, status badges (Available/Pending/Approved/Rejected/Taken), UPI ID input shown/required when claiming, and a contact info card including WhatsApp number. Use shadcn/ui building blocks already present (Card, Input, Button, Badge, etc.). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add a small shared mapping/utility for consistent status label text + badge classnames (amber/charcoal palette) used by both user and admin Live List Checker UIs.

requirements.summary: Extend Admin Panel with a Live List Checker tab for managing name lists, claims review/actions, limits/amounts, totals, and contact info.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can paste/upload a list of names and submit it; the list becomes active immediately for user checks.
Admin can see a table/list of claims with name, UPI ID, status, and timestamp.
Admin can approve or reject a claim; the claim status updates in the UI after action.
Admin can set limits and per-claim amount, and see totals computed from claims.
Admin can edit and save contact info including WhatsApp number.

file_operations.description: Add a new Admin Panel tab/section for Live List Checker and wire it into the existing shadcn Tabs layout. Keep existing admin PIN gating behavior intact. The new section should support: bulk paste and/or file upload for names, claim queue table with status filter, approve/reject actions, limits/per-claim amount form, totals display, and contact info editor (WhatsApp number included). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create an admin-focused component used by AdminPanel that provides: name list upload/replace (textarea and optional file parse), claims table (name, UPI ID, status, timestamp) with filtering, approve/reject controls, limits + per-claim amount editor, totals cards, and contact info editor (WhatsApp number). Use the new hooks and invalidate/refetch after mutations. Use shadcn/ui components already in the project (Table if available, otherwise Cards + ScrollArea + rows). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Apply a distinct warm amber + charcoal theme for Live List Checker UI with consistent cards/badges and accessible form states (no blue/purple primary).
acceptanceCriteria: Live List Checker UI uses consistent typography, spacing, and components (cards, badges, inputs, dialogs) aligned with the existing design system.
Status (Available/Pending/Approved/Rejected/Taken) is clearly distinguishable using consistent badge colors and text labels.

file_operations.description: Add Live List Checker-specific utility classes (scoped, non-global-primary) to support a warm amber + charcoal look (card borders/background accents, button variants if needed, and status badge colors). Ensure Live List Checker components use these utilities instead of the existing purple/blue gradient utilities for their primary actions.

Ensure the user Live List Checker section consistently uses the amber/charcoal styling utilities and clearly distinguishes statuses with consistent badge colors/labels. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Ensure the admin Live List Checker section consistently uses the amber/charcoal styling utilities and clearly distinguishes statuses with consistent badge colors/labels. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
